names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ιουβενάλιος ο Μάρτυρας», with the rank words left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Ιουβενάλιος μαρτύρησε το 132 μ.Χ., επί αυτοκράτορα Αδριανού (117 - 138 μ.Χ.).» The page heads him «(; - 132)», with no year of birth. The year and the reign agree.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ιουβενάλιος ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole text is one sentence with a year in it. **He is neither of the two Juvenals the corpus keeps**: `juvenal-of-jerusalem` is the fifth-century patriarch and `juvenal-of-alaska` the missionary killed in 1796. This one is dated 132 under Hadrian and is nothing but a name, a rank, a year and a day. No place, no manner of death, no judge, no relics, no hymn, and no couplet.
